currentGoalBinding.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann eine Aussage mithilfe geeigneter Beispiele sowie Rand- und Spezialfälle auf Plausibilität prüfen und die Wahl der Beispiele begründen.
currentGoalBinding.descriptionEn: The learner can test a statement for plausibility using suitable examples as well as boundary and special cases, and justify the choice of examples.
currentGoalBinding.scopeDecision: Appropriate teaching example for selecting contrasting integer cases and distinguishing plausibility from proof; not an assessment of independent example selection. No finite boundary of the integers is invented.

generationProvenance.note: Earlier-candidate rejection is supplied context, not independently re-adjudicated here. No pixel-identical preservation claim or rights clearance is made.

mathematicalChecks.observation: (-2) times (-1) equals 2; both negative signs and parentheses are visibly unambiguous; 2 is even.
0 times 1 equals 0; zero is even because 0 = 2 times 0. The special case is correctly included.
The conjecture is stated over all integers. The four matching cases are explicitly not called a proof. Green checks label individual even results, not the universal statement.
Ein Gegenbeispiel würde die Vermutung widerlegen is a correct conditional statement about universal conjectures, not a claim that this true conjecture has a counterexample.

visualChecks.style: pass: friendly abstract comic learner, clear rounded pastel cards, restrained decorative marks; no photorealism or sterile plot replacement
visualChecks.background: pass: actually viewed image has a light opaque background and legible dark title; PNG truecolour type 2 has no alpha channel
visualChecks.germanTextAndNotation: pass: title, conjecture, case labels and limiting conclusion are complete, correctly spelled and clearly separated
visualChecks.layout: pass: conjecture above four parallel cases and explicit limited conclusion below; no overlapping formulas, clipped task text, foreign logo or watermark observed
visualChecks.legibility: pass at inspected native 1536 by 1024 view; full phone-size legibility without enlargement is not certified
visualChecks.promptCompliance: Substantive formulas and requested words preserved. Minor decorative styling is immaterial; uniform exact colour or pixel equality was not required for fachliche acceptance.

suggestedAltTextDe: Eine mathematische Vermutung wird an vier unterschiedlichen ganzen Zahlen geprüft: Für n gleich minus zwei, null, eins und fünf ergeben n mal n plus eins die geraden Zahlen zwei, null, zwei und dreißig. Die Grafik betont, dass diese passenden Beispiele noch kein allgemeiner Beweis sind; ein Gegenbeispiel würde eine Allaussage widerlegen.
